title: insonic import manifest
description: Batch import input for the CLI and its GUI wrapper. Syntax validation precedes application validation of source access, calendar values, timezone/DST policy and admission. No approval per item is required for already configured routing.

schema_version.description: Version of the insonic document contract.

kind.description: Document discriminator used by the master registry.

defaults.description: Recording-date defaults and policies. Exact timestamp, calendar date and approximate UTC range are mutually exclusive.

originated_at.description: Entered recording timestamp, distinct from import, publication and file modification times.

originated_on.description: Entered recording date when the recording time is unknown.

timezone.description: Timezone for unzoned recording timestamps; local is resolved once for the batch.

dst_fold.description: Explicit choice of offset for an ambiguous repeated daylight-saving wall time.

dst_gap.description: Explicit policy to resolve a nonexistent wall time by shifting forward; absent means no silent correction.

copy.description: True admits a managed copy into the selected artifact store; false keeps an explicitly tracked local reference.

preset.description: Configured processing/import preset name or ID; does not embed provider configuration.

date_precedence.description: Versioned recording-date precedence rule. Filesystem modification becomes a recording-date candidate only under the explicit filesystem-fallback rule.

originated_earliest.description: Inclusive earliest recording instant for an owner-supplied approximate date range. Preserve the exact UTC timestamp and integer clock.

originated_latest.description: Inclusive latest recording instant for an owner-supplied approximate date range. Application validation checks bound ordering.

local_http.description: Explicitly elect HTTP credential transport for a loopback endpoint only. Credentials otherwise require HTTPS; unauthenticated HTTP sources remain supported.

acquisition_max_bytes.description: Maximum acquired original bytes, default 64 GiB. Declared and streamed lengths are bounded before publication.

acquisition_timeout_ms.description: Positive total acquisition deadline in milliseconds, default ten minutes. Per-item values override batch defaults.

transcript_max_bytes.description: Independent transcript acquisition and document byte ceiling (maximum 16 MiB).

transcript_timeout_ms.description: Independent transcript acquisition timeout in milliseconds.

attribution.description: Preserve existing assignments; derive structured participation only when none exist. Diarize explicitly elects configured acoustic processing without recognition.

transcript_format.description: Explicit native or Cue JSON format hint validated against input bytes.

replace_transcript.description: Elect replacement when the target already has a current transcript.

subtitle_stream_index.description: Absolute embedded subtitle stream index to select.

diarization_model_id.description: Shared model reference; submission freezes an exact compatible target before acquisition and processing.

replace_audio.description: Explicit election to replace canonical audio at an existing stable recording.

existing_transcript.description: Required document election when replacement has a current transcript.

transcript_applies.description: Affirm that the current transcript applies to elected replacement audio.

existing_roster.description: Explicit declared-roster election during audio replacement.

known_speakers.description: Initial declared identities by UUID or unique exact canonical name/active alias. Empty declares an empty roster.

items.description: Inputs in deterministic admission order, with independent partial-result reporting.
